entities.question: What is the title of the work?

content_blocks.label: body_text
content_blocks.text: In the heart of the city, there's a hero who has been quietly saving lives for years without ever seeking recognition. Meet Sarah Thompson, a nurse at St. Mary's Hospital who has been known to perform countless acts of kindness and bravery. From helping lost children find their way home to intervening during medical emergencies, Sarah's selflessness is a testament to the good that can be done by one person. Her story is a reminder that sometimes, the greatest heroes wear no cape and are found in the most unexpected places.
